title: Twigs x Blue Skies
description: Gives Vanilla minecraft and also Blue Skies better stick textures :3
body:
Made to unify the stick textures in the Blue Skies dimension mod with the Twigs texture pack! I made all the retextures myself with the Twig base but i still think i did good job!

To my testing this works on 1.20.1 and I had to use the extracted file in my resource pack folder to get it to show up, so im sorry if it doesnt work.. 

**Twigs is not required to run this! But you do need Blue Skies (obviously)**

Twigs:
https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/texture-packs/twigs
Blue Skies:
https://modrinth.com/mod/blue-skies
